output.summary: Attrition (14.1% trailing, 13.6% senior) is below the firm's 5-year average and the regional median, and paired resignations have happened before. Both September leavers had decided on other grounds well before the Friday change (client in-house role, spouse's residency), so a retention crisis and a Friday-driven exit story are not supported. Friday dissatisfaction is real and concentrated (flexibility 3.9 to 3.1), but intent to stay and engagement are flat. The Executive Committee knowingly accepted this tradeoff and set review triggers. Best action is to report the numbers, keep the existing monitoring and January review, and communicate the rationale and invite input on implementation. A $30,000 bonus and punitive tracing of associates are unjustified. Whether the junior skill gap has closed is unmeasured, and Q1 and Q2 would test it.
